recipes.title: Spicy Chicken & Turmeric Rice with Tzatziki

items.i: flat-leaf parsley, chopped, plus extra to garnish

steps: Mix the chicken with the onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chilli powder, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken in batches for 6–7 minutes until cooked. Set aside.
In the same pan, melt the butter and toast the rice for 2 minutes to pick up the chicken flavour.
Add the turmeric, paprika, cumin, stock, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat for 4 minutes, then fluff.
Mix the Greek yogurt, squeezed cucumber, lemon juice, garlic, dill, parsley, salt and pepper.
Divide the rice and chicken between 5 containers (about 420 g each), drizzle with tzatziki (or pack it separately) and garnish with parsley. Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; per-container nutrition (556 cal, 53 g protein, 52 g carbs, 13 g fat) is from his card. It's only mildly spicy; skip the chilli for none.
